## Story

Story ID and owner:
Contract version:

## Change

What changes for the caller or user, and why?

## Validation

List the commands actually run and link their results. State the tested sizes,
seeds and tool versions where relevant. Identify stubs, skipped checks and
hardware/formal work that has not run.

## Review

- [ ] Acceptance criteria met or unfinished items explicitly listed
- [ ] Applicable tests and CI pass
- [ ] Shared interfaces unchanged, or contract change identified
- [ ] Owner can explain the implementation
- [ ] AI usage entry and relevant documentation updated

Normal review: R1 -> R2, R2 -> R3, R3 -> R1.
Contract changes require both non-author approvals and author sign-off.
Do not mark the story Done until it has been reviewed and merged.
